Performed by a master flutist, this piece captures the essence of Raga Jait, a traditional Indian classical raga known for its serene and contemplative mood. Let the soothing sounds of the flute transport you to a place of peace and introspection.
Credits:
Song: Jait (Bibhas Ang)
Artist: Pt. Hariprasad Chaurasia
Music Director: Traditional
Lyricist: NA
